<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_USICourseRegistration" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USICourseRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Register" name="Start course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsSplit" name="Slots free?" default="Flow_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCourses" name="Show courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourseDate" name="Select course and date"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoSlots" name="No free slots"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountSplit" name="Has account?" default="Flow_NoAccount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleSplit" name="Registered at eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request account activation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Msg_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountJoin" name="Account available"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetSplit" name="Invite friends?" default="Flow_NoTweet"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends via Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetJoin" name="Continue registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueTicket" name="Issue course ticket"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TicketIssued" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_Register" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToSlots" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsSplit" targetRef="Task_ShowCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${slotsAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSlots" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsSplit" targetRef="End_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowToSelectDate" sourceRef="Task_ShowCourses" targetRef="Task_SelectCourseDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectDateToAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourseDate" targetRef="Gateway_AccountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountSplit" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleSplit" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eligibleUniversity}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResponseToJoin" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToLogin" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountJoin" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToTweetSplit" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_TweetSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetSplit" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inviteFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTweet" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetSplit" targetRef="Gateway_TweetJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_TweetJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteToPayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TicketToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="End_TicketIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
